title: Unreadable documents
summary: Interpret body availability and base claims on the text you can read.
purpose: Interpret body availability and base claims on the text you can read.
request: Check `content_state` from {{route:document.read}} and reread when needed.
response: `readable` means the read succeeded. A document containing only front matter is empty. `file_path_missing` means no recorded path, `file_not_found` means no file at the path, and `path_unresolved` means the repository could not resolve it.
errors: Record the unavailable state and continue using verified material. Use a document-bound question if a decision requires the missing body.
